register_repeated_dense: register a dense layer with KFAC using the repeated_dense variant for vmap-applied layers
register_qmc: register a dense layer with KFAC using the qmc variant for Quantum Monte Carlo layers
RepeatedDenseBlock: create a Kronecker-factored curvature block for dense layers repeatedly applied via vmap

GRAPH_PATTERNS: use the graph patterns tuple to match repeated dense layer computations in the tagged JAX graph
